name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 38 - Am 121
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 38. Recalls that the Union has no autonomous power of taxation; rejects the introduction of new Union taxes and any new own resources that would increase the overall burden on citizens and businesses or diminish the fiscal sovereignty of the Member States; considers that GNI- and VAT-based resources, while legally classified as own resources, must be presented transparently as payments ultimately borne by the Member States and their taxpayers; stresses that the repayment of NGEU and other Union borrowing must not be used to establish a permanent fiscal capacity or debt union at Union level;
